description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan chargeback scenarios, specifically testing transactions that involve repayment, chargeback, goodwill credits, payouts, and refunds within the Apache Fineract project. It utilizes JUnit 5, REST-assured for API testing, and references various helper classes to create and manage loans, clients, and transactions.

classes.name: LoanChargebackOnPaymentTypeRepaymentTransactionsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing loan transaction chargeback scenarios like repayment, goodwill credits, payouts, and refunds within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured specifications and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: loanTransactionChargebackForPaymentTypeRepaymentTransactionTest
methods.description: Tests the successful chargeback of various repayment transactions, verifying transaction relations and outstanding balances after each operation.

methods.name: loanChargebackNotAllowedForReversedPaymentTypeRepaymentTest
methods.description: Verifies that applying a chargeback on a reversed or non-eligible transaction returns an error (HTTP 503).

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Helper method to create and approve a new loan account.

methods.name: reviewLoanTransactionRelations
methods.description: Checks the transaction relations and outstanding balances for a specific loan transaction.

methods.name: createRepaymentPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Creates an advanced payment allocation data object for repayment scenarios.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Creates a default payment allocation data object.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationOrder
methods.description: Generates a list of PaymentAllocationOrder objects based on provided payment types.

methods.name: loanProductFactory
methods.description: Provides different configurations of loan products for parameterized tests.
